organization_note: Amazon develops the Nova models, and Amazon Web Services, of Seattle, serves them through Amazon Bedrock and builds Amazon Quick, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Kiro, and the Strands Agents SDK. The catalog names the developer Amazon and the Bedrock operator Amazon Web Services, so both names belong to this record.
